gold-price-set-in-india.myth: MCX gold price is decided in India.

slides.title: It starts in New York
slides.body: COMEX gold futures on the New York Mercantile Exchange set the overnight reference price. By 6 AM IST, the global gold price has already moved — driven by US jobs data, Fed signals, and dollar strength. India has zero say in this.
slides.callout: India's contribution to the MCX gold price: 0%

slides.title: The rupee does the multiplying
slides.body: MCX gold price = COMEX $/oz ÷ 31.1035 × 10 × USD/INR + import duties. When the rupee falls 2%, MCX gold rises ~2% — even if COMEX is completely flat. The currency does the moving, not India.
slides.callout: ₹1 USD/INR move = ₹1,000–1,300 MCX gold move

slides.title: Import duties add a fixed layer
slides.body: India adds 6% BCD + 3% AIDC + 3% GST on gold imports (~12–13%). When Budget 2024 cut the duty from 15% to 6%, MCX gold fell ₹5,000–6,000 per 10g in a single trading day.
slides.callout: Budget 2024 duty cut → ₹5,000 drop in one trading day

gold-price-set-in-india.punchline: Watch COMEX. Watch USD/INR. Not Dalal Street.

mcx-closes-at-5pm.myth: MCX closes at 5 PM like the stock market.

slides.title: MCX trades until 11:30 PM IST
slides.body: NSE and BSE close at 3:30 PM. MCX runs from 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM IST — a 14.5-hour window. The real gold and crude moves happen after 7 PM, when the US market opens. If you're closing at 5 PM, you're missing most of the action.
slides.callout: MCX hours: 9:00 AM – 11:30 PM IST (14.5 hours)

slides.title: The US session is where gold moves
slides.body: Gold, silver and crude make their biggest daily moves during the US market session. COMEX opens at ~6:30 PM IST. The EIA crude inventory report drops every Wednesday at ~8:00 PM IST. This is when positions are made or broken.
slides.callout: Best hours for gold, silver & crude: 7 PM – 11:30 PM IST

slides.title: Base metals peak earlier
slides.body: Copper, Zinc, Lead and Aluminium track the London Metal Exchange (LME). Their peak volatility window is 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM IST, around the LME Ring close — well before the US session starts.
slides.callout: Copper & base metals peak: 3:30 PM – 6:30 PM IST

mcx-closes-at-5pm.punchline: MCX is an evening game. 7 PM is when it starts for gold and crude.

crude-follows-brent-exactly.myth: MCX Crude Oil exactly tracks Brent crude.

slides.title: MCX tracks WTI — not Brent
slides.body: MCX Crude Oil is benchmarked to WTI (West Texas Intermediate) futures on NYMEX, not Brent on ICE London. The two prices diverge by $2–8 per barrel on a regular basis. When WTI and Brent move differently, MCX follows WTI — not what you see on the news.
slides.callout: MCX crude benchmark: WTI (NYMEX), not Brent (ICE London)

slides.title: USD/INR runs through the middle
slides.body: Even when WTI moves exactly 1%, MCX crude may move 0.5% or 1.5% depending on what the rupee does. The conversion is: MCX ₹/bbl = WTI $/bbl × USD/INR. Two numbers, one MCX price. A weak rupee amplifies every WTI move.
slides.callout: MCX ₹/bbl = WTI $/bbl × USD/INR — currency always in the formula

slides.title: A 6.5-hour gap creates daily surprises
slides.body: WTI closes for active trading at ~2:30 AM IST. MCX reopens at 9 AM IST. During that 6.5-hour gap, the price is static on MCX while WTI continues to move. The first MCX crude candle often gaps significantly from the previous MCX close.
slides.callout: 6.5-hour gap: WTI close (2:30 AM IST) → MCX open (9 AM IST)

crude-follows-brent-exactly.punchline: Watch WTI. Track USD/INR. Account for the session gap.

need-1-lakh-to-trade-mcx.myth: You need ₹1 lakh to start trading MCX.

slides.title: Crude Mini starts at ₹3,000
slides.body: MCX Crude Oil Mini (10 barrels) requires just ₹3,000–5,000 in SPAN margin — the cheapest entry point in Indian commodity markets. One lot controls ₹65,000–80,000 of crude, giving roughly 13–20× leverage from a few thousand rupees.
slides.callout: MCX Crude Oil Mini: ₹3,000–5,000 SPAN margin required

slides.title: Silver Micro is ₹5,000
slides.body: MCX Silver Micro (1 kg lot) costs ₹5,000–8,000 in margin. This gives you direct silver price exposure without the ₹1.5 lakh needed for a full Silver contract (30 kg). India's smallest silver lot is designed for retail traders.
slides.callout: MCX Silver Micro (1 kg): ₹5,000–8,000 SPAN margin

slides.title: The real minimum is 1.5–2× margin
slides.body: Opening a position with just the margin amount is how beginners get forcibly squared off on the first significant move. Recommended starting capital: 1.5–2× the margin in your account to absorb intraday mark-to-market swings without a broker closeout.
slides.callout: Rule: Always keep 1.5–2× margin in account — never just the margin

need-1-lakh-to-trade-mcx.punchline: Start small, trade micro. Build experience before size.

commodities-riskier-than-stocks.myth: Trading MCX is much riskier than stocks.

slides.title: Leverage is the risk — not the commodity
slides.body: A small-cap stock can fall 20% in a week. MCX gold rarely moves more than 1–2% in a day. Commodity trading feels riskier because of leverage: you put up 5–8% margin to control 100% of the contract value. The underlying commodity is often less volatile than equities.
slides.callout: MCX gold typical daily move: 0.3–1.5%

slides.title: Commodity prices have physical floors
slides.body: A small-cap stock can go to zero — the company can fail. MCX gold cannot go to zero: it has a global industrial and monetary floor. Crude Oil cannot stay below global production cost for long. Physical fundamentals cap commodity downside in ways equities don't have.
slides.callout: Stocks can go to ₹0. Commodities have physical value floors.

slides.title: Compare futures to futures
slides.body: If you compare MCX futures to equity futures — same leverage structure, same margin system — the volatility is similar. Nifty futures can gap 2–3% on a bad day. A 2% MCX crude move is not unusual. The structure is identical; only the underlying changes.
slides.callout: Nifty futures vs. MCX crude: comparable daily volatility

commodities-riskier-than-stocks.punchline: Manage the leverage. The commodity itself isn't the enemy.

physical-gold-cheaper-than-mcx.myth: Buying physical gold is cheaper than MCX.

slides.title: Making charges: 8–25% on top
slides.body: Jewellery carries making charges of 8–25% on top of the gold rate. A ₹92,000/10g gold price becomes ₹99,000–1,15,000/10g by the time you hold the jewellery. MCX futures: zero making charges. Pure price exposure.
slides.callout: Physical jewellery markup: 8–25% making charges above gold rate

slides.title: 3% GST is a permanent cost
slides.body: Buying physical gold — jewellery, bars, or coins — attracts 3% GST, paid upfront at purchase. This 3% is not recovered when you sell. MCX futures have no GST on the commodity itself, only on brokerage fees.
slides.callout: GST on physical gold: 3% upfront (not recovered on resale)

slides.title: MCX gives pure price exposure
slides.body: MCX Gold Mini (100g) tracks the 999.9 purity spot price — no making charges, no metal GST, no storage cost. For anyone who wants to profit from gold price moves, MCX is structurally far cheaper than buying physical gold.
slides.callout: MCX Gold Mini: pure 999.9 purity price — no making charges

physical-gold-cheaper-than-mcx.punchline: Physical gold is for gifting. MCX is for trading.

tax-on-mcx-same-as-equity.myth: MCX profits are taxed at 15% STCG like stocks.

slides.title: MCX = business income at slab rate
slides.body: MCX commodity futures profits are classified as non-speculative business income by the Income Tax Act. You pay tax at your full income slab rate — up to 30%. There is no 15% STCG or 12.5% LTCG benefit that equity traders enjoy.
slides.callout: MCX profit tax: your full income slab rate — up to 30%

slides.title: CTT not STT — and it's deductible
slides.body: Equity trades attract STT (Securities Transaction Tax), which is not deductible. MCX trades attract CTT (Commodity Transaction Tax) at 0.01% on the sell side. The key advantage: CTT is fully deductible as a business expense. STT is not.
slides.callout: CTT 0.01% (sell side only) — deductible as business expense

slides.title: Losses carry forward 8 years — but file ITR-3
slides.body: MCX trading losses can be carried forward for 8 years to offset future commodity trading profits. They can only offset non-speculative business income — not salary income. You must file ITR-3, not ITR-2. Get a CA who knows derivatives.
slides.callout: Loss carry forward: 8 years | File: ITR-3 (not ITR-2 or ITR-1)

tax-on-mcx-same-as-equity.punchline: Factor your full slab rate into every P&L calculation before you trade.
